scope: All emitted paths and selected text formats; hashes and level-9 gzip sizes for every regular file. HTML asset attributes, CSS url(), JS quoted static asset paths, and manifest icons/start_url are resolved locally. No network requests.
limits: Targeted common credential signatures and private-source path checks, not a comprehensive secret or binary metadata audit.
Computed URLs and browser/deployed-host behavior require journey checks; this scanner does not execute application code.
Size ceilings are provisional local review regression limits, not maintainer-agreed performance budgets or measured user experience.
External resource references are inventoried by protocol only, not fetched or qualified.
